name: Dinner with Demian
source:
a short visual novel fan-game where you have dinner with demian from limbus company.

This is a fan-work that takes place in the world of Project Moon's City featuring a character from Limbus Company. While this game contains no spoilers, it is highly recommended to have sufficient knowledge to fully appreciate this fan-work.

[From [url=https://reqons.itch.io/dinner-with-demian]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一款简短的视觉小说同人游戏，你可以在其中与Limbus公司的德米安共进晚餐。

这是一部发生在Project Moon's City世界中的同人作品，主角是Limbus Company的角​​色。虽然本游戏不包含剧透，但强烈建议你拥有足够的知识才能充分欣赏这款同人作品。

[来自[url=https://reqons.itch.io/dinner-with-demian]Itch.io[/url]]
